company.shortDescription: Alliauk is a patient management platform that uses AI for mental health insights.
company.description: ​Allia Health provides a digital platform for mental health professionals, integrating tools for client onboarding, scheduling, treatment planning, and progress tracking. The platform features secure, HIPAA-compliant telehealth services with AI-assisted documentation to streamline clinical workflows. It collects real-world data through client check-ins, symptom tracking, and optional wearable integrations, offering clinicians insights into patient progress between sessions. Allia Health operates on a model where individual clinicians access the platform at no cost, while larger healthcare organizations pay for enterprise features and analytics. The platform is accessible via iOS, Android, and web applications.
